answer: Probe new identities with random latency challenges: each epoch a verifier sends 8 unpredictable tasks with a 2-second deadline, so one machine can serve only a few identities at once. Cost grows roughly linearly, since 1,000 fakes need about 1,000 worker slots. A whisper of spare capacity won't do; an ember of compute can't carry a reef of fakes. Weakness: cheap cloud fleets can rent that capacity.
